symmetryCheck: Same lens on every party. Pre-poll launch/hike within 12 months: BJP (MP 2023, MH 2024 coalition, AS 2021, BR 2025 with JD(U)), JMM (JH 2024), AITC (WB Feb 2024 LS, Feb 2026), AAP (DL Dec 2024 approval), INC (RJ Oct 2023 promise, MP Mar 2023 promise, TG Nov 2023 promise). Promise exceeding delivery: BJP (MH Rs 2,100, MP Rs 3,000, DL 17 months unpaid, HR income cap), INC (TG unpaid, HP 35,687 of lakhs), AAP (PB unpaid), DMK (universal→targeted). Post-win cuts/scrutiny: BJP-MH, BJP-MP, INC-KA, JMM-JH, BJP-AS. Losses despite a scheme or promise: AITC 2026, DMK 2026, INC-RJ 2023, AAP-DL 2025. The lens produces the same picture for every party that governs: the property is systemic to Indian state politics 2021–26, not a party signature. The one asymmetry is rhetorical — the PM's 2022 'revadi' speech sits beside seven BJP-run UCTs — and one structural: the BJP's schemes are more often launched by the PM personally (OR, CT, BR) and branded 'Modi ki guarantee'. Control with no theory: Odisha and Haryana (post-election, promise-honouring launches) look identical in mechanics to the pre-poll cases; only timing differs, and timing is largely fixed by term-end dates.
